subject: Commitment credit rail, drawdown telemetry & VAT evidence onboarding
content:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightlane.co>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marco.silva@brightlane.co, finance@brightlane.co
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual committed spend: invoicing cadence & VAT evidence

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. To move BrightLane onto Redwood's annual committed spend model we need to confirm two things before procurement raises the PO: 1) the invoicing cadence and drawdown mechanics (what our AP team will see each month), and 2) the VAT evidence package you will provide for EU filings.

High level asks from our side:
- Clear CSV ledger each month with drawdown amount, invoice number, and remaining credit balance (our ERP requires invoice-level references).
- PDF pack for VAT: signed SOW, entity-level VAT registration numbers, and proof-of-residency for the Redwood billing entity.
- DocuSign link for the commitment SOW and confirmation of the start date and available credit window.

Can you share a sample CSV format and a short runbook for how to surface VAT evidence to our tax team? If we get those by EOD Tuesday we can queue PO approval and send the signed SOW back the same week.

Best,
Elena
Finance Ops Lead
BrightLane Health

-----Original Message-----

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightlane.co>
Cc: marco.silva@brightlane.co, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual committed spend: invoicing cadence & VAT evidence

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. I attached a sample CSV (2026Q3-drawdown-template.csv) and a one-page VAT evidence checklist (BrightLane-VAT-evidence-instructions.pdf). Key notes on our side:

- Proposed cadence: Monthly invoices on the 1st of month covering the prior 30 days of consumption against the committed credit.
- Drawdown model: We issue a single invoice referencing the quarter-year commitment ID and include a line for the committed credit drawdown and any overage chargeable at standard rates. CSV columns included: invoice_date, invoice_number, drawdown_amount_eur, remaining_credit_eur, hubspot_deal_id.
- Ledger delivery: CSV pushed to secure SharePoint path + webhook notifying your finance mailbox when the file is available.
- VAT package: We will supply signed SOW (attached), Redwood EU billing entity VAT ID, and a PDF evidence bundle on the SharePoint link per invoice.

Action items I can take this week:
1) Publish final CSV template (attached).
2) Open DocuSign envelope for the SOW and loop in Marco for signature.
3) Coordinate with Kimberly in AR to map the CSV into our billing ledger and confirm PO matching rules.

If that matches your expectations I will kick off DocuSign today and flag finance ops for a short onboarding call to walk through the CSV-to-ERP mapping.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual committed spend: invoicing cadence & VAT evidence

Ben / Jonas,

Quick internal note so Finance Ops and AR are aligned before we push to the customer:

- The CSV template is acceptable but we need to confirm the invoice_number format to allow automated PO matching for EU customers (our ERP expects prefix REDW-YYYYMM-XXXX). Please update the template to include that pattern.
- VAT evidence bundling: finance requests that each invoice folder on SharePoint contains a single PDF named <invoice_number>-VAT-evidence.pdf with the three required artifacts (SOW, billing VAT ID, proof-of-residency).
- For accounting: we should include a monthly webhook payload sample for BrightLane's AP so their system can auto-consume the CSV and mark invoices as applied to the committed credit.

Jonas — can you draft the webhook payload example and confirm schema (timestamp, invoice_number, drawdown_amount, balance_remaining, doc_link)? Marissa — please hold any billing runs until we confirm the invoice_number pattern and we have DocuSign completed.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Head of AR Operations

-----Original Message-----

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightlane.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Silva <marco.silva@brightlane.co>, finance@brightlane.co
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 14:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Annual committed spend: invoicing cadence & VAT evidence

Hi Ben / Kimberly,

This is perfect — the primary ask from AP was the invoice_number pattern and the single-PDF VAT bundle.

Two additional questions from tax:
1) Can Redwood provide signed proof that the billing entity is Redwood EU Ltd (VAT ID: GB999999999) on the SOW header?
2) For proof-of-residency we accept either a local VAT registration extract or a certificate of tax residence. Is one simpler on your side?

If you can confirm the invoice-number format and send the DocuSign link we will route this through procurement. We expect PO issuance within 48 hours after the signed DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Elena

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightlane.co>, Marco Silva <marco.silva@brightlane.co>, finance@brightlane.co
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Commitment credit rail, drawdown telemetry & VAT evidence onboarding

Elena / Marco —

Thanks — per Kimberly's ask we've updated the invoice_number pattern to REDW-YYYYMM-#### and attached an updated CSV (2026Q3-drawdown-template.csv). Jonas attached a sample webhook payload and I created the DocuSign envelope (DocuSign-Commitment-SOW.pdf).

Short summary of the final runbook attached:
- Invoice cadence: Monthly (1st), CSV posted to secure SharePoint path + webhook POST to finance@brightlane.co with payload (invoice_number, drawdown_amount_eur, remaining_credit_eur, doc_link).
- Invoice numbering: REDW-YYYYMM-#### (4-digit sequence resets monthly).
- VAT evidence: Single PDF per invoice folder <invoice_number>-VAT-evidence.pdf containing signed SOW, Redwood EU Ltd VAT registration extract (GB999999999) and proof-of-residency (we will provide the VAT extract).
- Acceptance: PO expected within 48 hours post DocuSign signing. Once signed we will enable the monthly invoicing pipeline and provide a test webhook to your AP mailbox.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Marco (BrightLane): Sign DocuSign envelope (by end of day Mon 12 Jul)
- Ben (Redwood): Send test webhook and finalize SharePoint permissions (by Tue 13 Jul)
- Kimberly / Jonas (Redwood): Confirm CSV ingestion mapping with BrightLane AP during 30-minute onboarding call (TBD)
- Marissa (Redwood Billing): Hold first invoice until DocuSign complete and we have PO number

Attachments: 2026Q3-drawdown-template.csv (sample), BrightLane-VAT-evidence-instructions.pdf (checklist), DocuSign-Commitment-SOW.pdf (envelope).

If that's good I will mark the HubSpot deal DL-2026-0521-BL as moving to Contracting and update the billing ops ticket.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
